digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and timezone semantics
propositions: Enable Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families in global configuration after resolving all current diagnostics across src/rebar and tests
Validate all timestamp semantics use explicit UTC timezone (datetime.timezone.utc for epoch seconds and timezone-less persisted strings) rather than naive or host-local datetime
Security-pin cadence must remain a host-local calendar-date decision by obtaining an aware instant with explicit tz parameter, converting to host timezone, then extracting date
Prohibit the literal datetime.UTC token in production src/rebar Python files and require datetime.timezone.utc instead (py310 compatibility)
Create tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py to assert ASYNC/DTZ selection, verify absence of Ruff S selector and Semgrep configuration files, and scan for datetime.UTC violations
Prove timezone invariance of validation behavior by running tests under at least two distinct TZ environment values on platforms supporting time.tzset
